items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: The Simon Mare. He sold me a bass for $7. I'll never forget.

ctx.x: Before we go into that boat and all, you remember the very first job you ever played and the first band you ever played?

Yeah. Yeah. Well, it was during the time I was learning. When I first started, I bought the bass about the day after Lent, right after Mardi Gras. Yeah. The Simon Mare. He sold me a bass for $7. I'll never forget. And I had been working as a shoeshine boy then out on Royal St. Charles Street and like that in those shoeshine things. And I made nice money. I had about $40 then. And I gave him money to buy me a bow and strings and paid him for the bass. So I never forget. He bought everything and strung the bass up.
